title: Urjiilee Kudha Tokko Kan Sagadan
intro: Namni Qur’aana irraa argame tokko ijoollummaa isaatti mul’ata gadi fagoon kennameef — abjuu qaamolee samii kabajaan jilbeenfachuu. Mul’anni kun osoo hin dhugoomin waggoonni gantummaa, addaan ba’uu, himannaa sobaa fi hidhaa keessa darbu turan. Lubbuun dandamattuu seenaan ishee boqonnaa dheeraa Qur'aana dhuunfatte kun eenyu?
clues: Yeroo tokko dargaggeessa ture, abjuu dinqisiisaa abbaan koo illee akkan dhuunfaa koo akkan eegu na akeekkachiise tokkoon eebbifame.
Obbolaan koos hinaaffaan jaamsuun natti shira xaxanii boolla gadi fagoo fi dukkanaa’aa keessa na gatan.
Gara biyya fagootti na geessuun mana qondaala kabajamaa tokkootti na gurgurame, achittis tola argadhee itti gaafatamummaatti ol ka’e.
Himannaan sobaa hidhaa haqa malee naaf taasise, ammas bakka dukkanaa sana keessatti kadhannaa fi sujuuda Rabbiin jajjabina argadhe.
Rabbiin dandeettii abjuu hiikuu baay’ee hin argamneen na eebbise, kunis dhuma irratti bulchaa lafaa duratti na fidee sadarkaa imaanaa ol’aanaatti na ol guddiseera.
Waggoota dheeraaf addaan bahee booda maatii koo isa jaallatamaa wajjin deebiʼee kan wal argee siʼa taʼu, abjuun ijoollummaa koo urjii kudha tokko, aduu fi jiʼi naaf sagaduu dhumarratti raawwatame.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
